Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE extra-wide architectural interior design comparison board, a clean equal two-panel diptych of EXACTLY THE SAME standalone dining sideboard, seen from identical near-frontal camera at eye height 1450 mm, straight verticals, full floor-to-ceiling cabinet visible with narrow warm-white wall margins and pale oak floor. Landscape approx 2:1. LEFT panel all artificial lights OFF under soft natural daylight. RIGHT panel ALL cabinet lighting and modest ceiling fill ON at 3000K, with the SAME daylight, camera, exposure, cabinet geometry and objects. Left and right must be an exact geometric match, no rearrangement. Small clean labels only at top "A · 全关灯" and "A · 全开灯". No other text, no dimensions, no watermarks.

A new standalone proposal; NOT a depiction of an already installed room. No table/chairs in foreground, no changes to whole apartment, no copied reference room.
